title: 翻译部分概览
goal: 了解翻译任务及总体评分标准

points.label: 说出翻译任务及材料长度和时间
区分两档译文的总体表现

sources.title: CET笔试
sources.used: 任务数量、时间和卷面权重

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 原文长度和翻译评分标准

rows.v: 将 1 段中文译成英语

rows.src: c2 大纲 第 3 节

cards.title: 总体评分
rows: 准确表达原意，行文流畅
用词贴切，基本没有语言错误，只有个别小错
用词欠准确，语言错误相当多，有些是严重错误
cards.note: 评分看译文的总体表现。意思、连贯、结构和用词不单独计分。

options: Translate one Chinese passage into English.
Translate one English passage into Chinese.
Summarize two Chinese passages in English.
Revise two English passages in Chinese.
items.why: 任务是将一段中文译成英语，对应第一项。

items.stem: How long is the Chinese source passage?
options: 120–140 Chinese characters
140–160 Chinese characters
140–160 English words
160–180 Chinese characters
items.why: 原文长度为 140–160 汉字，对应第二项。

items.stem: How much time is allotted to translation?
options: 15 minutes
25 minutes
30 minutes
40 minutes
items.why: 翻译部分的时间是 30 分钟，对应第三项。

options: The meaning is barely conveyed, with many language errors.
The meaning is accurately conveyed, with many serious errors.
The meaning is barely conveyed, but the wording is apt.
The meaning is accurately conveyed in fluent, apt English.
items.why: 13–15 分档准确表达原意，用词贴切，行文流畅，对应第四项。第二项意思准确，但错误多，不符合这一档。

options: The meaning is barely conveyed, with many errors, some serious.
The meaning is accurately conveyed, with only a few minor errors.
The meaning is barely conveyed, but the wording is apt and fluent.
The meaning is accurate, but there are many errors.
items.why: 7–9 分档勉强表达原意，语言错误相当多，有些是严重错误，对应第一项。

items.stem: How are meaning, coherence, structure and wording assessed?
options: Each of the four dimensions receives the same fixed share of marks.
They contribute to an overall assessment of the translation.
Only the number of wording errors determines the result.
Meaning and wording are scored separately, then added up.
items.why: 翻译按总体表现评分，四个方面不单独计分，对应第二项。
